    Bug 2059675 - Override new Nova theme changes in Add-ons Manager. r=aleca
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D315541

diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn b/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn
index 749331b153a..d6f574766b4 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/jar.inc.mn
@@ -115,6 +115,10 @@
 % override chrome://global/skin/icons/check.svg chrome://messenger/skin/icons/new/compact/check.svg
 # End Supernova icon overrides
 
+# Nova icon overrides
+% override chrome://mozapps/content/extensions/default-theme/preview-nova.svg chrome://mozapps/content/extensions/default-theme/preview.svg
+# End Nova icon overrides
+
   skin/classic/messenger/abContactsPanel.css                  (../shared/mail/abContactsPanel.css)
   skin/classic/messenger/abFormFields.css                     (../shared/mail/abFormFields.css)
   skin/classic/messenger/about3Pane.css                       (../shared/mail/about3Pane.css)
diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/mail/aboutExtra.css b/mail/themes/shared/mail/aboutExtra.css
index e581ab63afd..f516228114b 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/mail/aboutExtra.css
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/mail/aboutExtra.css
@@ -48,6 +48,11 @@ button[name="plugin"] {
   --main-margin-start: 28px;
 }
 
+/* Hide the Nova theme color selection */
+aboutaddons-themes-mode {
+  display: none !important;
+}
+
 /* Hide in extension details the private browsing section */
 section > .addon-detail-row-private-browsing,
 .addon-detail-row-private-browsing + .addon-detail-row.addon-detail-help-row {
diff --git a/mail/themes/shared/mail/variables.css b/mail/themes/shared/mail/variables.css
index 68a7b81f50f..5d9c5001106 100644
--- a/mail/themes/shared/mail/variables.css
+++ b/mail/themes/shared/mail/variables.css
@@ -139,6 +139,7 @@
   --button-border-color-primary: var(--button-primary-border-color);
   --button-border-color-primary-hover: var(--button-primary-border-color);
   --border-radius-medium: var(--button-border-radius);
+  --input-search-border-radius: var(--button-border-radius);
 
   --tabline-color: var(--selected-item-color);
